name: causal_execution
purpose: Repair the information boundary of opening execution before further strategy selection.

constraints.risk_controller: latched; original high-water mark; no restoration after 8%

execution.order_information: Prior completed close, preceding available labels, prior ADV and ATR, predeclared risk and allocation rules.
execution.opening_information: Current opening quote, prior close, announced ex-date reference adjustments. No same-day high, low, close, amount or full-session volume.
execution.fill: Tick-valid opening-price proxy; refuse missing, invalid, explicitly suspended or directionally limit-blocked openings. This is not an observed auction fill or queue simulation.
execution.slippage: Separate nonnegative cent-rounded cash cost on executed gross at 10/20/30 bps per side. Do not also shift the execution price.
execution.fees: Existing commission, minimum commission, transfer and stamp assumptions on proxy gross; dividend conventions unchanged.
execution.unknown_status: Record absent point-in-time suspension, ST and listing coverage as a data limitation; never infer opening tradability from full-day volume.

comparisons.name: execution_bridge
comparisons.inputs: Frozen outer predictions, calibration, selected rule schedule and original data.
comparisons.changes: Execution and separately booked slippage only.
comparisons.interpretation: Diagnostic attribution; original inner selections may contain execution bias.

comparisons.name: data_bridge
comparisons.inputs: Same frozen predictions and research rules, corrected engine.
comparisons.changes: Only verified data corrections, if available; report changed coverage and labels.

comparisons.name: causal_retraining
comparisons.inputs: All 11 windows plus latest fit; original candidate and turnover budgets, model hyperparameters and selection thresholds.
comparisons.changes: Repeat fitting, calibration and validation selection with corrected execution. No reuse of old validation account caches.

evaluation.scope: 11 outer folds, 23 complete 10-session accounts, one partial tail and a 231-session continuous account per policy and cost on the original calendar.
evaluation.inference: The historical period has already been inspected. No pristine holdout or prospective claim; costs are separate path scenarios, not independent samples.
evaluation.correctness_gate: Opening perturbation invariance, integer-cash reconciliation, independent fill/cost audit, T+1 and risk/cap checks must pass before interpreting returns.
evaluation.superiority_gate: Diagnostic bridge cannot certify alpha. Keep original research-only decision until separately preregistered comparative and forward gates pass.
evaluation.failure_policy: Keep corrected causality even if returns decline. Persist failures and investigate, without changing thresholds after outer results.

later_research.budget: At most 6 separately preregistered single changes, then at most 2 combinations chosen only on inner data.
scope: drawdown recovery as an isolated candidate
later_research.registration_required: Register concrete hypotheses, thresholds and multiplicity treatment before running new candidate outcomes.
